title: What kind of time commitment does occupational therapy require from parents?
metaTitle: Parents' Time Commitment in Occupational Therapy - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Understand the commitment involved in occupational therapy for your child at Pinnacle Blooms Network. Beyond sessions, our therapists guide parents on activities for home practice.
html: As your child's biggest advocate, your involvement in the therapeutic process is priceless. At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we understand that every family's schedule is different. The time committed by parents does depend on the recommended frequency of the therapy sessions, but more than that, it includes the invaluable time spent at home encouraging, supporting, and participating in home-based activities suggested by the therapists. This home practice is critical as it reinforces the skills learned in therapy and integrates them into your child'ss daily routines, making them a natural part of their life.
